title: Verificar GET de audio TTS ya cacheado sin nueva generación
mission: From a network-capable verifier, issue only a read-only GET for the known existing cache id audio-lab-page-v1-clara-r1-164wms against audio-lab-page-audio-v1. Confirm non-empty audio and cache headers without any POST generation.
definition_of_done: GET ?id=audio-lab-page-v1-clara-r1-164wms returns a non-empty audio response or the exact HTTP/network divergence is recorded.
When successful, x-audio-lab-cache is HIT and x-audio-lab-bytes is non-zero.
No POST request and no new TTS generation is performed.
Result is persisted with timestamp and exact endpoint; no authority promotion occurs.
